summary: Briery Knob lookout (Pocahontas Co., WV), mentioned from 1913-14; the Register says it was dismantled with portions moved to Nettie FD, but FFLA lists a standing tower there.

facts.status_note: Register: original tower dismantled, portions moved to Nettie FD. FFLA lists a standing tower at Nettie FD

access.note: No public access described in the sources read. The relocated parts are at a volunteer fire department, so ask the department first

events.note: State warden's biennial report for 1913-14: the Cherry River Boom and Lumber Company built more than 25 miles of telephone line to reach the Briery Knob and Job Knob stations
1916 report names watchman S.A. Sparks, who lived at Lobelia and stayed at the station at night in high fire danger
Tower reported connected to two telephone companies (newspaper, as quoted by Forest Lookouts)
Forest supervisor said the road to the tower would be improved for tourists (newspaper, as quoted by Forest Lookouts)
Registered January 26, 2017; nominated by Brian M. Powell
Register: tower dismantled, portions relocated to Nettie Volunteer Fire Department. FFLA: standing tower at Nettie FD, relocated from Briery Knob

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA lists the original site as gone and a standing tower at Nettie FD; the Register says the original was dismantled and only portions moved. Not resolved; the story reports both.
Register gives 4,517 ft (1,377 m); the 1916 report gives 4,534 ft. Not resolved; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build date; the 1913-14 warden report is the earliest mention. The 1926 and 1938 newspaper items are only as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the originals were not checked. Only the FFLA list ties a standing tower to Nettie FD, and it conflicts with the Register's dismantled note. A photo of the Nettie FD tower would settle the status.
